Al Nahdi Pharmacy (Nahdi Medical Co.) was founded by [Abdullah Amer Al Nahdi](https://www.forbes.com/profile/abdullah-amer-al-nahdi/), who serves as the vice chairman. The company is publicly traded on the Saudi Exchange. Major stakeholders include the [Al Nahdi Family Office](https://www.forbesmiddleeast.com/lists/top-100-arab-family-businesses-2026/al-nahdi-family-office/) and [SEDCO Holding](https://sedco.com/en/story/nahdi-medical-company/) (Saudi Economic and Development Company). [](https://www.forbes.com/profile/abdullah-amer-al-nahdi/)

- **Founder:** Abdullah Amer Al Nahdi started the business in 1986 by buying two pharmacies in Jeddah.

- **Public Company:** It became a public joint-stock company on the Saudi Exchange in 2022.

- **Major Investors:** SEDCO Holding acquired a 50% stake in 2003 and retains significant investment alongside the Al Nahdi Family Office. [](https://sedco.com/en/story/nahdi-medical-company/)
